english.note: Use this when speaking directly to a group and referring back to everyone being addressed.
Use this for plural “yourselves” when the people addressed are the reflexive object.

examples.english: You yourselves decide; we’ll handle it ourselves.
examples.traditional: 你哋自己決定，我哋自己搞掂啦。

examples.english: You should take care of yourselves.
